s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive lower urinary tract symptoms with urethral mass and amyloid protein deposition
salient_findings: Nocturia two to three times per night
key_facts: 53-year-old man
3-year history of lower urinary tract symptoms
No history of lichen sclerosis
No history of sexually transmitted infection
No history of pelvic radiation
No history of genitourinary trauma
No family history of genitourinary malignancy
Normal renal ultrasonography findings
Flexible cystourethroscopy revealed a circumferential urethral mass
Biopsy specimens were negative for carcinoma
Biopsy specimens demonstrated amyloid protein deposition
No additional disease manifestations of amyloidosis found
Retrograde urethrography showed an approximately 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra

differentials: Squamous cell carcinoma of the urethra
per_call: Squamous cell carcinoma of the urethra

shortlist.label: Amyloid-associated urethral stenosis
shortlist.why_kept: Biopsy specimens demonstrated amyloid protein deposition and retrograde urethrography showed urethral stenosis

shortlist.label: Primary amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Amyloid protein deposition found in biopsy specimens, suggesting possible systemic amyloidosis

shortlist.label: Urethral stricture
shortlist.why_kept: Retrograde urethrography showed an approximately 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra

shortlist.label: Secondary amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Amyloid protein deposition found, but no additional disease manifestations of amyloidosis, considering secondary cause

shortlist.label: Urothelial carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Initial suspicion due to circumferential urethral mass, although biopsy was negative, it remains a consideration due to clinical presentation

raw.rationale: The presence of a circumferential urethral mass with biopsy specimens demonstrating amyloid protein deposition and the absence of carcinoma, along with a 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra, best supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Primary amyloidosis
rejected.why: No additional disease manifestations of amyloidosis were found, making primary amyloidosis less likely.

rejected.label: Urethral stricture
rejected.why: While urethral stricture could explain the stenosis, it does not account for the amyloid protein deposition found in the biopsy specimens.

rejected.label: Secondary amyloidosis
rejected.why: There is no evidence of chronic infection or inflammation that would typically precede secondary amyloidosis.

rejected.label: Urothelial carcinoma
rejected.why: Biopsy specimens were negative for carcinoma, ruling out urothelial carcinoma as the cause of the urethral mass.
